problem.title: Python - How to write a Windows path to a json file?
problem.description: I am working together with a colleague and he has Ubuntu while I have Windows. We have a dataset of JSON files which have in them a "path" written. His paths look like this: 'C:/Users/krock/Desktop/FIIT/BP/Ubuntu/luadb/etc/luarocks_test/modules/30log/share/lua/5.3/30log.lua' But this doesn't work on Windows, I was trying to do some_string.replace('/', '\\') But this results in strings written in json that look like this: 'C:\\Users\\krock\\Desktop\\FIIT\\BP\\Ubuntu\\luadb\\etc\\luarocks_test\\da
